documents.name: leave.txt
documents.text: Vacation policy. Employees receive twenty days of paid vacation leave each year. Unused leave carries over up to five days.

documents.name: remote.txt
documents.text: Remote work policy. Employees may work remotely three days each week. Manager approval is required for international remote work.

documents.name: incident.txt
documents.text: Incident response. Error E42 indicates an expired service certificate. Renew the certificate and restart the gateway.

documents.name: expenses.txt
documents.text: Expense reimbursement policy. Submit receipts within thirty days. The meal allowance is forty dollars per day.

documents.name: backup.txt
documents.text: Database backup policy. Backups run daily at midnight and are retained for thirty days. Restore drills run monthly.

documents.name: access.txt
documents.text: Access security policy. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory. Access reviews take place quarterly.
